secondaryValue: Verbose, Standard, Minimal, OTC Only, Off
fieldDescription:
Controls how much C2 chatter appears in the on-screen combat feed:
- Verbose: All enabled signals with tactical reasons.
- Standard: Concise 1-line signals; skips opening formation and routine re-targeting chatter.
- Minimal: Only OTC orders and critical friendly plays (strikes, relief, venting).
- OTC Only: Only fleet commander (OTC) phase and order signals.
- Off: Mutes all on-screen C2 chatter.

Rendering quality for Time, Space, Firepower, and Convergence overlays:
- High: Smooth polar contours and anti-aliased rings.

fieldDescription:
Choose between Division AI's dynamic combat music or vanilla Starsector combat music:
- Division AI Dynamic Music: Continuous ambient base layer with dynamic faction combat tracks and pause fade-out.
- Vanilla Default: Uses vanilla Starsector combat music.
